checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One approximately 8-second widescreen video shows an animated seed sprouting.
must.why: Widescreen and a sprouting is shown, but the clip is 5 s, not about 8 s.

must.item: The audible voice-over says the supplied script verbatim, without extra spoken lines.
must.why: Audio can't be judged from frames; the assistant's message mentions no narration.

must.item: Water reaches the seed, roots grow downward, and a shoot grows upward toward light in that order.
must.why: No water is shown, and no roots are visible underground. Only a shoot emerging is shown.

must.item: The corresponding growth stages appear while the narration describes them.
must.why: There is no narration to check against, and the water and root stages are missing.

must.item: There is no on-screen text or music.
must.why: No on-screen text is visible. Music can't be verified.

exact_text.text: A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward, and a shoot reaches up toward the light.
exact_text.read_as: No text on screen (it was meant as a voice-over, not on-screen text).

faults.what: The clip is 5 s, not about 8 s.
No water-absorption stage and no visible roots growing downward; the clip skips straight to the shoot.
No narration is mentioned or evident; the script was not delivered as voice-over.
The seed goes from intact (0.5 s) to a full seedling with leaves (2 s). The growth is abrupt and looks like a morph. Leaf and stem shapes look slightly unnatural.

summary: The clip is a nice-looking 5-second widescreen seed-to-seedling shot, but it lacks the water and root stages, the 8-second length and the scripted voice-over.
